The pipeline configuration in [.github/workflows/deploy.yml](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-h0yYpN/workspace/.github/workflows/deploy.yml) has been updated to reorder the workflow jobs so fast static and unit checks execute first.

### Key Changes
- **`lint` & `unit`**: Moved to the beginning of the DAG with no `needs` dependencies so they start immediately in parallel upon `push`. Any syntax or linting error (such as a missing semicolon) will fail within seconds.
- **`staging`**: Now requires `needs: [lint, unit]`, preventing deployment to staging and execution of the long integration suite if lint or unit tests fail.
- **`integration` & `production`**: Preserved in the pipeline downstream of staging deploy (`integration` needs `staging`, `production` needs `integration`).

### Verification
- Inspected [.github/workflows/deploy.yml](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-h0yYpN/workspace/.github/workflows/deploy.yml) to confirm valid YAML syntax, correct job dependencies (`needs`), and that all five existing checks (`lint`, `unit`, `staging`, `integration`, `production`) are present.
- Confirmed no application files (`src/`, `test/`, `integration/`, `scripts/`, `Dockerfile`, `package.json`) were altered.
